overview.en: A Brazilian catfish recorded from the Paraíba do Sul and Jequitinhonha basins.
overview.fr: Un silure brésilien signalé dans les bassins du Paraíba do Sul et du Jequitinhonha.

identification.en: It is one of six recognized Steindachneridion species; the genus revision describes several characters shared by its members.
identification.fr: C’est l’une des six espèces reconnues de Steindachneridion ; la révision du genre décrit plusieurs caractères communs à ses membres.

ecology.en: It shares a Jequitinhonha record with congener S. amblyurum.
ecology.fr: Il partage un signalement dans le Jequitinhonha avec son congénère S. amblyurum.

facts: FishBase lists the Paraíba do Sul and Jequitinhonha basins, freshwater demersal habitat and a global Endangered assessment dated 7 November 2018; its summary lacks diet and breeding detail.

title.en: Revision of genus Steindachneridion — Neotropical Ichthyology
title.fr: Révision du genre Steindachneridion — Neotropical Ichthyology

facts: The revision recognizes S. parahybae among six extant congeners and describes shared anatomical and fin characters.

facts: FishBase records S. amblyurum from the Jequitinhonha basin, one of the two basins listed for S. parahybae.

title.en: Surubim-do-Paraíba — São Paulo State Fisheries Institute
title.fr: Surubim-do-Paraíba — Institut des pêches de l’État de São Paulo

facts: A state fisheries publication identifies S. parahybae as surubim-do-Paraíba and describes it as threatened in the Paraíba do Sul basin.
